lines.text: What would happen if all eight billion people on Earth gathered and jumped simultaneously?
Imagine crowding the entire human population into an area the size of Los Angeles.
On the count of three, everyone jumps one foot into the air and slams back down together.
The impact would deliver a colossal kinetic shockwave of several petajoules into the ground.
Yet because the Earth weighs six sextillion tons, our combined jump wouldn't budge the planet by even the width of an atom.
However, the thunderous sound wave of billions of landing feet would rupture millions of eardrums.
Physics shows that against planetary mass, humanity is merely a speck of dust.
